intent: Capability-parity roadmap for building complete games with Genesis Engine, informed by publicly described Unreal Engine feature areas.

legal_and_architecture_boundary.note: Implement independently specified, interoperable capabilities. Do not copy proprietary Unreal Engine source code, private implementation details, assets, or documentation text. Capability names are generic engineering requirements, not assertions of exact one-to-one internal equivalence.

completeness_definition: Inventory the target feature areas and their sub-capabilities.
Map every target capability to a Genesis Engine contract, an explicit exclusion, or a documented external dependency.
Record source path, exact source SHA, symbol kind/name, tests and acceptance evidence for implemented capabilities.
Mark a capability VERIFIED only when its acceptance gates pass at the exact source SHA.
Treat platform-specific features and optional integrations as adapter contracts until a real supported backend and test evidence exist.
